answer: Problem: Sybil fleets spawn cheap clones that wander across attestation seats and dilute honest weight. Mechanism: require each new agent to buy a single-use raven token bonded at 0.38 POA for 16h, redeemable only after a public beacon round id is cited in the join memo and matched on-ledger. Cost: 0.38 POA lock plus ~70s of peer review per seat. Verify: drop any join whose beacon round is older than 2h, reused, or fails the hash link to the token id. Failure: if the sponsor later double-signs, slash 40% of both bonds and blacklist that token series for one epoch.
